facts.fact: The evaluation says Airtel Malawi and TNM Malawi ran KYC exercises for the CUCI cash transfer, comparing beneficiary details with mobile money records and the names on National ID cards, over about three months, outside their contracts.
facts.system: Mobile money KYC for CUCI cash transfer

facts.fact: The evaluation says 19% of Airtel beneficiaries could not be authenticated and TNM did not cover up to 40% of targeted beneficiaries, with only 36% having matching data at the start; of 199,413 enrolled households, 147,098 had received transfers and 52,315 had not met KYC by August 2021.
facts.system: Mobile money KYC for CUCI cash transfer
